entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I didn't expect to find the world's savior[n]alone on Christmas Eve.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Can I talk to you for a minute?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: First off, thank you for taking my request.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: With your actions, I can only hope that[n]public opinion changes... It will change,[n]won't it?
I'm sure it will.
I don't know.
We'll find out.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I believe so, too.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...True. It was social reform on a scale[n]no one has ever accomplished before.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But I believe that it will.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Shido confessed to a variety of crimes.[n]We can arrest him on those charges.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...The problem lies in proving him guilty.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It'd be difficult unless the correlation[n]between the Metaverse and the mental[n]shutdowns is made.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Akechi, who perpetrated those crimes,[n]has gone missing... You're the only ones[n]left who can testify.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...I'll be blunt.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I want you to turn yourself in to the police.
Turn myself in...
Why?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Your testimony will be necessary in order[n]to prove Shido guilty... However...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That will mean placing you on center[n]stage. You'll be treated as a hero who[n]saved this country...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But there's no way that the police or the[n]public prosecutors will let that slide.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...They'll lose face to you and the[n]Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If that happens, there's no telling what[n]they'll do to you or your teammates.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There's even the possibility that they'll[n]fabricate a crime and move to arrest[n]you all.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: If you turn yourself in to the police,[n]you'll definitely be arrested.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: And there's your past record. The police[n]and prosecution will strike there.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: They'll treat your arrest as "grave[n]misconduct" and revoke your[n]probation...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You'll most likely be sent to juvenile hall...[n]and placed in solitary confinement.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: They'll be content as long as they get[n]a testimony without the Phantom[n]Thieves being hailed as heroes.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: That should guarantee the safety of your[n]teammates. Or rather, I'll make sure it's[n]guaranteed.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'll close all the cases surrounding Shido.[n]I intend to expose them all.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It's to prevent society from becoming[n]distorted again. That's what you want[n]too, isn't it?
We succeeded in changing[n]not only Shido's heart, but that[n]of the general public as well...
The cognitive Metaverse has[n]disappeared too, along with[n]that malevolent god...
However, it sounds like my[n]testimony is necessary for[n]them to find Shido guilty...
But there's no knowing what the[n]police would do. They'd never let[n]a phantom thief be the hero...
Having said that, my[n]testimony would at least[n]keep my teammates safe...
They'd know I was acting[n]out of line while under[n]probation though...
This might be the only way[n]to ensure all our efforts[n]don't go to waste...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This is almost like... a final deal between[n]the two of us.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'll ask you once more.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I'd like for you to turn yourself in to[n]the police, of your own accord.
I'll save my teammates.
If it'll help reform society.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Thank you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I had a feeling you'd say that... Leave the[n]rest to us.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: All right, let's go.
